question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Attain
solution:
The correct answer is **"Achieve."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Attain"** means to achieve or reach a goal. ((किसी कार्य या वस्‍तु को) करने या पाने में सफल होना, विशेषतः काफ़ी प्रयत्‍न के बाद)

 
 
• **Example**: *She worked hard to **attain**__ her dream of becoming a doctor.*
 
 
 
• **"Achieve"** is a synonym of **"attain."**
 
• **"Achieve" **means to complete something by hard work and skill. (किसी कार्य को मेहनत व कौशल द्वारा संपन्‍न करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *They have **achieved**__ a lot in a short time.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Abandon) **means to give up or leave behind. (किसी प्राणी या वस्‍तु को, जिस का उत्तरदायित्‍व आप पर है, प्रायः सदा के लिए छोड़ देना)
 
• **Option 3 (Destroy)** means to ruin or demolish. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना)
 
• **Option 4 (Commence)** means to begin or start. (आरंभ होना)
